About us

Urban Craft & Co.

Corporate gifts chosen for the people receiving them. From the first shortlist to the final branding approval, we help you put a considered gift together.

Explore the collection WhatsApp us

Urban Craft & Co. helps companies choose and brand gifts for employees, clients and events. We work from New Delhi, and our catalogue includes boxed gift sets, laptop bags, backpacks, duffles, jute and felt bags, drinkware, conference folders and employee welcome kits.

Most of our clients come to us with a rough idea: a number of people, an occasion and a date. We help turn that into a specific selection, confirm which branding method works for each product, and coordinate the order from there.

Our approach is simple - show real products clearly, avoid surprises, and keep one point of contact through the process.

How we work

One contact, from shortlist to dispatch

You browse and shortlist; we confirm branding, quantities and packing, and keep you posted until the order is delivered.

Browse the catalogue See our services

How it works

From shortlist to delivery in four steps

  1. 01

    Browse & shortlist

    Save products to favourites or send us a category you like.

  2. 02

    Share your brief

    Quantity, timeline, logo and delivery location - whatever you know so far.

  3. 03

    Review options

    We confirm branding methods and suggest alternatives where needed.

  4. 04

    Approve & dispatch

    Approve the final selection and artwork; we take it from there.

Why Urban Craft & Co.

Practical reasons teams work with us

  • Range in one place

    Gift sets, bags, drinkware, folders and onboarding kits in one place - fewer vendors to manage.

  • Branding checked per product

    We confirm which customization method suits each material before you commit.

  • Guided enquiries

    Share as much or as little as you know. We help narrow the options.

  • Considered presentation

    Sets arrive boxed and arranged, so the gift feels finished when it is opened.
